name: Hantu Tetek
description: Hantu Tetek (Malay 'breast ghost'), also known as Hantu Kopek, is a female ghost in Malay folklore depicted as an old woman with grotesquely enlarged, pendulous breasts. She is said to smother victims, especially disobedient children who wander out at night, and is mainly invoked as a cautionary figure.
origin: Predominantly Malaysia, with comparable variants in Indonesia and Brunei among Malay-language communities.
